# telnyx_10dlc_campaign_appeal (Action)

Appeals a 10DLC campaign that Telnyx or a carrier rejected (status TELNYX_FAILED or MNO_REJECTED). The appeal goes to Telnyx compliance for manual review and the campaign returns to TCR_ACCEPTED.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `appeal_reason` (String) Detailed explanation of why the campaign should be reconsidered and what changes have been made to address the rejection reason.
- `campaign_id` (String) The campaign id.
